> [!CAUTION]
> **DO NOT post sensitive security vulnerabilities in public issues.**
> Publicly disclosed security flaws can put active users and data at risk.

## How to Report Security Issues Safely

If you discovered a potential vulnerability in Snap-it:

1. **GitHub Security Advisory:** Open a private report through our [Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/MRINALPRAKASHFSD/snap-it/security/advisories/new).
2. **Direct Security Email:** Send an encrypted or direct email to `mrinalprakash9123@gmail.com` with the subject `[SECURITY VULNERABILITY]`.

### Please Include:
- Vulnerability description and impact level.
- Step-by-step reproduction instructions or a minimal script.
- Component involved (`drizzle/migrations`, `src/lib/camera`, `src/integrations/supabase/`, etc.).

We acknowledge incoming vulnerability reports within 24 hours. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for full response timelines and our safe harbor pledge.
